answer: Locks are recorded in violet, expire in canyon, and signal lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 125 aliases as a result needs 57 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3311 identities would post 3718 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
